text: APPROVE. The extraction keeps the original evaluation order and early exits, so behaviour is unchanged. The parent method and each new helper should sit well under 15 complexity, and I see no construct that would break a warnings-as-errors build. I could not see the top of `CryptoKeyBindingType`, so I am assuming its `line` variable is `lines[i]`, which the unchanged `IsMemberOfIdentifierTable(lines, i, …)` calls suggest.
